facts.fact: The British Deputy High Commissioner said at the 30 October 2026 forum that joint UK-Kenya digital inclusion programmes have reached more than 1.2 million citizens with digital literacy training, including 30,000 young people in basic training and over 10,000 in advanced employability skills, per The Star.

At a forum on 30 October 2026 validating a Digital and ICT Accessibility Maturity roadmap, Kenyan officials said public institutions are to audit their websites and online platforms and draw up plans to remove barriers for persons with disabilities, and the disability office is drafting inclusive communication guidelines on sign language, captioning and accessible documents, per The Star.
